[EN] Mission Orders

The cultists inside the Dark Cathedral are a threat to everything we know.

Hunt {@LinkCreature:25#2011#ossugon warchiefs}, {@LinkCreature:25#2021#ossugon legates}, {@LinkCreature:25#2031#devan deathmasters}, {@LinkCreature:25#2041#Lokian snipers}, {@LinkCreature:25#2042#Lokian blood reapers}, {@LinkCreature:25#2061#devan vanguards}, {@LinkCreature:25#2071#dark deacons}, {@LinkCreature:25#2091#Lokian zealots}, and {@LinkCreature:25#2092#Lokian fanatics}.

Report to Coordinator Delwen when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los cultistas dentro de la Dark Cathedral son una amenaza para todo lo que conocemos.

Caza {@LinkCreature:25#2011#ossugon warchiefs}, {@LinkCreature:25#2021#ossugon legates}, {@LinkCreature:25#2031#devan deathmasters}, {@LinkCreature:25#2041#Lokian snipers}, {@LinkCreature:25#2042#Lokian blood reapers}, {@LinkCreature:25#2061#devan vanguards}, {@LinkCreature:25#2071#dark deacons}, {@LinkCreature:25#2091#Lokian zealots} y {@LinkCreature:25#2092#Lokian fanatics}.

Preséntate ante la coordinadora Delwen cuando termines la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
